manualAcceptance.installationDecision: User deferred physical comparison/testing. Prepare and retain local Build 19; do not repeatedly request unlock or launch.

deviceChecks.procedure: On the iPhone, open both equipment courses, scrub every action, select/focus parts, restore overview, explode/reassemble and switch compact controls. Check visible geometry, original materials and reachable controls. Background and reopen each course.
deviceChecks.record: Build/device/OS, any clipped or stale frame, crash or unexpected pose change, screenshots only when useful

deviceChecks.procedure: Measure first and repeated native model load, frame timing during orbit and movement, and peak memory during a complete turbofan walkthrough using device profiling. Include device/OS and repeat conditions.
deviceChecks.record: Actual load durations, frame-time distribution and memory; Simulator load timings cannot fill this result

deviceChecks.procedure: Use Read step and English next, back, replay, pause, resume and why commands. Confirm stopping voice and background return; with permission denied, touch navigation must remain usable.
deviceChecks.record: What was spoken and what happened on the real device; do not replace microphone evidence with command injection

passed: Restart lesson and Next step in studio

deviceChecks.procedure: In each equipment course, enter AR, allow camera if requested, scan a textured table and place the model. Orbit physically, drag/pinch/twist, play each action, check a hand crossing the model, interrupt tracking, rescan after background and return to 3D. Verify pose and step preservation.
deviceChecks.record: Actual device, build, visible camera/model, placement stability, artifact or gesture failures; Simulator fixtures cannot fill this result

result.motorPassed: camera, placement, brief stability, pinch/twist, five authored actions, studio return
result.failed: hand/model edges flicker even when hand is stationary

deviceChecks.procedure: In placed origami tabletop AR choose full-screen icon → Voice-only full screen. Wait for hint to disappear, then say Next step, Previous step, Show me again, Pause, Continue, and Read this step. Repeat in gearmotor/turbofan AR; equipment navigation should play the chosen action. Exit and verify step/partial pose/anchor retained. Check Stop listening and denied/unavailable speech recovery, tracking loss and background return.
deviceChecks.record: Real spoken phrases and actual observed response, microphone stop behavior, unreachable controls or lost pose; synthetic command/layout fixtures cannot fill this result

learnerChecks.procedure: Have a learner follow the three towel actions with a real towel. Record which instruction, camera angle or transition required extra help.
learnerChecks.acceptance: All three actions can be followed; any unclear step remains open for revision. One review is a usability check, not a learning-effectiveness statistic.

learnerChecks.procedure: Without coaching, ask a learner to locate the terminal lid, fan cover and output shaft group, replay their movements, and return the model to its assembled pose.
learnerChecks.acceptance: The learner can identify the intended virtual parts and operate the viewer; no claim about repairing a real motor.

learnerChecks.procedure: Ask a learner to locate the fan, compressors, combustor, turbines and exhaust, explain their order in this model, use a part close-up and return to the assembled overview.
learnerChecks.acceptance: Names, spatial order and virtual movements are understood. Resolve unclear course wording before calling the teaching sequence accepted.

manualAcceptance.contentReview: Source geometry and labels have local engineering review. Independent learning review remains pending. Model-specific maintenance instructions require separate authoritative review.
